DONNELLY, John (Donnycarney, Dublin 9 and late of the Department of Agriculture) 3rd June 2016, tragically in Turkey. Loving son of the late John. John will be very sadly missed by his loving mother Peg,  partner Gavin, sisters Geraldine, Valerie, Claire, Helen and Margaret, brother Brian, sister-in-law, brothers-in-law, aunts, nieces and nephews and many relatives.

 

Reposing at Staffords Funeral Home, Portmarnock on Monday, 13th June, from 5.30pm to 7.30pm. Funeral Service will be held on Tuesday 14th in Naomh Mearnog, GAA Club, Blackwood Ln, Portmarnock, Co. Dublin at 10.30am (sharp) followed by burial in Fingal Cemetery.

 

Rest in Peace

 

"The Show Must Go On"
